name: Barbarian
description: A fierce warrior of primitive background who can enter a battle rage, channeling primal ferocity to overwhelm foes.

features.name: Rage
features.description: In battle, you fight with primal ferocity. On your turn, you can enter a rage as a bonus action, gaining advantage on Strength checks and saving throws, a bonus to melee damage rolls, and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.description: While you are not wearing any armor, your Armor Class equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Constitution modifier.

features.name: Reckless Attack
features.description: You can throw aside all concern for defense to attack with fierce desperation. When you make your first attack on your turn, you can decide to attack recklessly, giving you advantage on melee weapon attack rolls using Strength during this turn, but attack rolls against you have advantage until your next turn.

features.name: Danger Sense
features.description: You have advantage on Dexterity saving throws against effects that you can see, such as traps and spells, as long as you are not blinded, deafened, or incapacitated.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

subclasses.name: Path of the Ancestral Guardian
subclasses.description: Barbarians who draw on the spirits of honored ancestors to shield allies and hinder enemies.

features.name: Ancestral Protectors
features.description: While you're raging, the first creature you hit with an attack on your turn has disadvantage on any attack roll that isn't against you until the start of your next turn, and when the creature hits a target other than you, that target has resistance to the damage dealt.

features.name: Spirit Shield
features.description: If you are raging and another creature you can see within 30 feet takes damage, you can use your reaction to reduce that damage by 2d6.

subclasses.name: Path of the Battlerager
subclasses.description: Dwarven barbarians who wear spiked armor into battle, using it as a weapon while raging.

features.name: Battlerager Armor
features.description: When you choose this path, you gain the ability to use spiked armor as a weapon. While wearing spiked armor and raging, you can use a bonus action to make one melee weapon attack with your armor spikes, dealing 1d4 piercing damage.

features.name: Reckless Abandon
features.description: When you use Reckless Attack while raging, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Constitution modifier.

subclasses.name: Path of the Beast
subclasses.description: Barbarians who channel bestial power, transforming their bodies into natural weapons when they rage.

features.name: Form of the Beast
features.description: When you enter your rage, you can transform, revealing the bestial power within you. You manifest a natural weapon: bite (1d8 piercing, regain HP on hit), claws (1d6 slashing each, extra attack), or tail (1d8 piercing, reaction to add 1d8 to AC).

features.name: Bestial Soul
features.description: The feral power within you increases, granting you a climbing speed, swimming speed, or the ability to extend your jump distance.

subclasses.name: Path of the Berserker
subclasses.description: Barbarians who channel their rage into a mindless fury, gaining unmatched offensive power at the cost of exhaustion.

features.name: Frenzy
features.description: You can go into a frenzy when you rage. If you do so, for the duration of your rage you can make a single melee weapon attack as a bonus action on each of your turns after this one. When your rage ends, you suffer one level of exhaustion.

features.name: Mindless Rage
features.description: You can't be charmed or frightened while raging. If you are charmed or frightened when you enter your rage, the effect is suspended for the duration of the rage.

subclasses.name: Path of the Giant
subclasses.description: Barbarians who channel the might of giants, growing in size and power during their rages.

features.name: Giant's Havoc
features.description: Your rage grants you the might of giants. Your reach increases by 5 feet, and when you hit with an attack, you can deal an extra 1d6 damage of your chosen elemental type. You can also become Large if you are smaller.

features.name: Elemental Cleaver
features.description: Your weapon attacks deal extra elemental damage and can push creatures 5 feet away from you.

subclasses.name: Path of the Storm Herald
subclasses.description: Barbarians whose rage generates a powerful aura of elemental energy — desert, sea, or tundra.

features.name: Storm Aura
features.description: You emanate a stormy, magical aura while you rage. The aura extends 10 feet from you in every direction. Choose desert (fire damage), sea (lightning damage), or tundra (temporary HP) — the effect activates when you enter your rage and as a bonus action on subsequent turns.

features.name: Storm Soul
features.description: You gain benefits based on your chosen environment: fire resistance (desert), lightning resistance and underwater breathing (sea), or cold resistance (tundra).

subclasses.name: Path of the Totem Warrior
subclasses.description: Barbarians who undertake a spiritual journey, bonding with a totem animal spirit that grants them supernatural abilities.

features.name: Totem Spirit
features.description: Choose a totem spirit and gain its feature. Bear: while raging, you have resistance to all damage except psychic. Eagle: opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage, and you can Dash as a bonus action. Wolf: while raging, your friends have advantage on melee attack rolls against any creature within 5 feet of you.

features.name: Aspect of the Beast
features.description: You gain a magical benefit based on the totem animal of your choice: Bear (carrying capacity doubled), Eagle (see up to 1 mile clearly), or Wolf (track creatures at fast pace).

subclasses.name: Path of Wild Magic
subclasses.description: Barbarians whose rage taps into wild magical forces, producing unpredictable magical effects.

features.name: Magic Awareness
features.description: As an action, you can sense the presence of spells and magic items within 60 feet of you. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

features.name: Wild Surge
features.description: When you enter your rage, roll on the Wild Magic table to determine the magical effect produced. Effects include teleportation, spectral flumphs, weapon infusion, and more.

subclasses.name: Path of the Zealot
subclasses.description: Barbarians fueled by divine power, fighting as champions of the gods and becoming increasingly difficult to kill.

features.name: Divine Fury
features.description: While you're raging, the first creature you hit on each of your turns with a weapon attack takes extra 1d6 + half your barbarian level in damage (necrotic or radiant, your choice).

features.name: Warrior of the Gods
features.description: Spells that restore you to life (but not Revivify) don't require material components when cast on you.

name: Bard
description: An inspiring magician whose power echoes the music of creation, using words, music, and magic to inspire allies and confound foes.
tool_proficiencies: Three musical instruments of your choice

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You have learned to untangle and reshape the fabric of reality in harmony with your wishes and music. Charisma is your spellcasting ability. You know two cantrips and a number of spells from the bard spell list.

features.name: Bardic Inspiration
features.description: You can inspire others through stirring words or music. As a bonus action, you give one creature within 60 feet a Bardic Inspiration die (d6). The creature can add the die to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw it makes within 10 minutes.

features.name: Jack of All Trades
features.description: You can add half your proficiency bonus, rounded down, to any ability check you make that doesn't already include your proficiency bonus.

features.name: Song of Rest
features.description: You can use soothing music or oration to help revitalize your wounded allies during a short rest. Any friendly creatures who regain hit points at the end of a short rest gain an extra 1d6 hit points.

features.name: Font of Inspiration
features.description: You regain all of your expended uses of Bardic Inspiration when you finish a short or long rest.

subclasses.name: College of Creation
subclasses.description: Bards who believe the cosmos is a work of art and channel the Song of Creation to animate objects and manifest wonders.

features.name: Mote of Potential
features.description: When you give a creature a Bardic Inspiration die, you can utter a note from the Song of Creation to create a Tiny mote that orbits within 5 feet of the creature, providing an additional effect based on how the die is used.

features.name: Performance of Creation
features.description: As an action, you can channel the Song of Creation to create one nonmagical item of your choice in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of you.

subclasses.name: College of Eloquence
subclasses.description: Bards who have mastered the art of oratory, able to stir the hearts of any audience with their words.

features.name: Silver Tongue
features.description: You can treat a roll of 9 or lower on a Charisma (Persuasion) or Charisma (Deception) check as a 10.

features.name: Unsettling Words
features.description: As a bonus action, you can expend one use of Bardic Inspiration to unsettle a creature within 60 feet. It subtracts the Bardic Inspiration die from its next saving throw before your next turn.

subclasses.name: College of Glamour
subclasses.description: Bards who learned their magic in the feywild, weaving enchanting performances that captivate audiences.

features.name: Mantle of Inspiration
features.description: As a bonus action, you can expend one use of Bardic Inspiration to grant up to 5 creatures within 60 feet temporary hit points equal to 5 + your bard level. Each creature can immediately use its reaction to move up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

features.name: Enthralling Performance
features.description: After performing for at least 1 minute, you can attempt to charm humanoids within 60 feet of you who watched the performance.

subclasses.name: College of Lore
subclasses.description: Bards who pursue knowledge and collect bits of lore from every source, becoming versatile jacks-of-all-trades.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency with three skills of your choice.

features.name: Cutting Words
features.description: When a creature you can see within 60 feet makes an attack roll, ability check, or damage roll, you can use your reaction to expend one use of Bardic Inspiration, rolling the die and subtracting the number rolled from the creature's roll.

subclasses.name: College of Spirits
subclasses.description: Bards who seek tales of the dead and channel stories of the past through their performances.

features.name: Guiding Whispers
features.description: You learn the guidance cantrip, which doesn't count against the number of bard cantrips you know.

features.name: Spiritual Focus
features.description: You can use a candle, crystal ball, skull, spirit board, or tarokka deck as a spellcasting focus for your bard spells. When you cast a bard spell that deals damage or restores hit points through your Spiritual Focus, roll a d6 and add the number rolled to one damage or healing roll of the spell.

subclasses.name: College of Swords
subclasses.description: Bards who use their weapons as instruments, performing deadly blade flourishes in combat.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency with medium armor and the scimitar. If you're proficient with a simple or martial melee weapon, you can use it as a spellcasting focus for your bard spells.

features.name: Blade Flourish
features.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can expend one use of Bardic Inspiration to perform a Defensive Flourish, Slashing Flourish, or Mobile Flourish, each adding the Bardic Inspiration die to your weapon damage roll.

subclasses.name: College of Valor
subclasses.description: Bards who inspire others in battle, blending magic with martial prowess to become warrior-poets.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency with medium armor, shields, and martial weapons.

features.name: Combat Inspiration
features.description: A creature that has a Bardic Inspiration die from you can roll that die and add the number rolled to a weapon damage roll it just made, or add it to its AC against one attack as a reaction.

subclasses.name: College of Whispers
subclasses.description: Bards who use knowledge and secrets as weapons, manipulating others through fear and subterfuge.

features.name: Psychic Blades
features.description: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend one use of Bardic Inspiration to deal an extra 2d6 psychic damage to that target.

features.name: Words of Terror
features.description: After speaking to a humanoid alone for at least 1 minute, you can attempt to magically frighten them. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of a creature of your choice for 1 hour.

name: Cleric
description: A priestly champion who wields divine magic in service of a higher power, serving as an intermediary between the mortal world and the divine.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: As a conduit for divine power, you can cast cleric spells. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability. You know three cantrips and prepare spells from the entire cleric spell list each day.

features.name: Divine Domain
features.description: Choose one domain related to your deity, which grants you domain spells and other features at 1st level and again at 2nd, 6th, 8th, and 17th levels.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Turn Undead
features.description: As an action, you present your holy symbol and each undead within 30 feet that can see or hear you must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the creature is turned for 1 minute or until it takes damage.

features.name: Destroy Undead
features.description: When an undead fails its saving throw against your Turn Undead feature, the creature is instantly destroyed if its challenge rating is at or below a certain threshold (CR 1/2 at 5th level, increasing at higher levels).

subclasses.name: Arcana Domain
subclasses.description: Clerics devoted to gods of magic and knowledge, blending arcane and divine magic.

features.name: Arcane Initiate
features.description: You gain proficiency in the Arcana skill, and you gain two cantrips of your choice from the wizard spell list, which count as cleric cantrips for you.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Arcane Abjuration
features.description: You can use your Channel Divinity to abjure otherworldly creatures, turning celestials, elementals, fey, and fiends as if they were undead.

subclasses.name: Death Domain
subclasses.description: Clerics who worship gods of death, undeath, and the transition from life to death.

features.name: Reaper
features.description: You learn one necromancy cantrip of your choice from any spell list. When you cast a necromancy cantrip that normally targets only one creature, the spell can instead target two creatures within range and within 5 feet of each other.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Touch of Death
features.description: You can use Channel Divinity to destroy another creature's life force with a touch, dealing extra necrotic damage equal to 5 + twice your cleric level.

subclasses.name: Forge Domain
subclasses.description: Clerics devoted to gods of the forge, creation, and craftsmanship who imbue objects with divine power.

features.name: Blessing of the Forge
features.description: You gain the ability to imbue magic into a weapon or armor. At the end of a long rest, touch one nonmagical armor or weapon, which becomes a magic item granting +1 to AC or attack and damage rolls until your next long rest.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Artisan's Blessing
features.description: You can use Channel Divinity to create a simple item, conducting an hour-long ritual that crafts a nonmagical item that must include some metal.

subclasses.name: Grave Domain
subclasses.description: Clerics who watch over the line between life and death, ensuring the dead rest in peace.

features.name: Circle of Mortality
features.description: When you would normally roll one or more dice to restore hit points with a spell to a creature at 0 hit points, you instead use the highest number possible for each die. You also learn the spare the dying cantrip, which has a range of 30 feet for you.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Path to the Grave
features.description: As an action, you choose one creature you can see within 30 feet and curse it. The next time that creature takes damage, it is vulnerable to all of that damage.

subclasses.name: Knowledge Domain
subclasses.description: Clerics of knowledge deities who value learning, understanding, and the sharing of information.

features.name: Blessings of Knowledge
features.description: You learn two languages of your choice and become proficient in two of the following skills: Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of those skills.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Knowledge of the Ages
features.description: You can use your Channel Divinity to tap into a divine well of knowledge. As an action, you gain proficiency with one skill or tool of your choice for 10 minutes.

subclasses.name: Life Domain
subclasses.description: Clerics focused on the vibrant positive energy that sustains all life, becoming some of the most accomplished healers.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.description: You gain proficiency with heavy armor.

features.name: Disciple of Life
features.description: Your healing spells are more effective. Whenever you use a spell of 1st level or higher to restore hit points to a creature, the creature regains additional hit points equal to 2 + the spell's level.

subclasses.name: Light Domain
subclasses.description: Clerics empowered by their deity to bring the light of truth and renewal, punishing the wicked with burning radiance.

features.name: Warding Flare
features.description: When you are attacked by a creature within 30 feet of you that you can see, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll, causing light to flare before the attacker before it hits or misses. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Radiance of the Dawn
features.description: As an action, you dispel any magical darkness within 30 feet and each hostile creature within 30 feet must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 2d10 + cleric level radiant damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.

subclasses.name: Nature Domain
subclasses.description: Clerics who serve gods of nature, gaining power over the elements and the ability to command animals and plants.

features.name: Acolyte of Nature
features.description: You learn one druid cantrip of your choice and gain proficiency in one of the following skills: Animal Handling, Nature, or Survival.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.description: You gain proficiency with heavy armor.

subclasses.name: Order Domain
subclasses.description: Clerics devoted to gods of law and order, inspiring discipline and obedience in their allies.

features.name: Voice of Authority
features.description: When you cast a spell with a spell slot of 1st level or higher that targets an ally, that creature can use its reaction immediately after the spell to make one weapon attack.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Order's Demand
features.description: As an action, each creature of your choice that can see or hear you within 30 feet must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you until the end of your next turn or until it takes damage.

subclasses.name: Peace Domain
subclasses.description: Clerics who foster bonds of unity and peace, magically linking allies together for mutual support.

features.name: Emboldening Bond
features.description: You can forge an empowering bond among people who are at peace with one another. As an action, choose a number of creatures equal to your proficiency bonus within 30 feet. For 10 minutes, a bonded creature can add 1d4 to an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw once per turn.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Balm of Peace
features.description: You can use your Channel Divinity to move up to your speed without provoking opportunity attacks, and when you move within 5 feet of any creature, you can restore hit points equal to 2d6 + your Wisdom modifier.

subclasses.name: Tempest Domain
subclasses.description: Clerics of storm gods who wield the power of thunder and lightning, inspiring fear in their enemies.

features.name: Wrath of the Storm
features.description: When a creature within 5 feet of you that you can see hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to cause the creature to make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d8 lightning or thunder damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Destructive Wrath
features.description: When you roll lightning or thunder damage, you can use your Channel Divinity to deal maximum damage instead of rolling.

subclasses.name: Trickery Domain
subclasses.description: Clerics of trickster gods who use deception, illusion, and stealth to confound their enemies.

features.name: Blessing of the Trickster
features.description: You can use your action to touch a willing creature other than yourself to give it advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. This blessing lasts for 1 hour or until you use this feature again.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Invoke Duplicity
features.description: As an action, you create a perfect illusion of yourself within 30 feet that lasts for 1 minute. You gain advantage on attack rolls against any creature within 5 feet of the illusion.

subclasses.name: Twilight Domain
subclasses.description: Clerics who guard the transition from light into darkness, providing comfort and protection in the dim hours.

features.name: Eyes of Night
features.description: You have darkvision out to a range of 300 feet. As an action, you can share this darkvision with willing creatures within 10 feet of you, up to a number equal to your Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Twilight Sanctuary
features.description: As an action, you present your holy symbol and a sphere of twilight emanates from you in a 30-foot radius. It lasts for 1 minute. When a creature ends its turn in the sphere, you can grant it 1d6 + cleric level temporary hit points or end one effect causing it to be charmed or frightened.

subclasses.name: War Domain
subclasses.description: Clerics of war gods who inspire valor in battle and channel divine power to strike down their foes.

features.name: War Priest
features.description: When you use the Attack action, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Guided Strike
features.description: When you make an attack roll, you can use your Channel Divinity to gain a +10 bonus to the roll. You make this choice after you see the roll, but before the DM says whether the attack hits or misses.

name: Druid
description: A priest of the Old Faith, wielding the powers of nature and adopting animal forms. Druids revere nature above all and gain their spells from the force of nature itself.
armor_proficiencies: Shields (druids will not wear armor or use shields made of metal)

features.name: Druidic
features.description: You know Druidic, the secret language of druids. You can speak the language and use it to leave hidden messages.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Drawing on the divine essence of nature itself, you can cast spells to shape that essence to your will. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.description: You can use your action to magically assume the shape of a beast that you have seen before. You can use this feature twice per short or long rest. Your druid level determines the beasts you can transform into.

features.name: Wild Shape Improvement
features.description: You can transform into a beast with a challenge rating as high as 1/2 (no flying speed). At 8th level, you can transform into a beast with a CR as high as 1.

subclasses.name: Circle of Dreams
subclasses.description: Druids with ties to the Feywild who can mend wounds and shepherd allies through the dreamlands.

features.name: Balm of the Summer Court
features.description: You have a pool of fey energy represented by a number of d6s equal to your druid level. As a bonus action, you can spend dice to heal a creature within 120 feet and grant it temporary hit points.

features.name: Hearth of Moonlight and Shadow
features.description: During a short or long rest, you can create an invisible 30-foot sphere of protective magic. Creatures within gain +5 to Stealth and Perception checks, and light from open flames is not visible outside the sphere.

subclasses.name: Circle of the Land
subclasses.description: Druids who are mystic keepers of ancient knowledge, drawing additional power from the land they are most connected to.

features.name: Bonus Cantrip
features.description: You learn one additional druid cantrip of your choice.

features.name: Natural Recovery
features.description: During a short rest, you can recover expended spell slots with a combined level equal to or less than half your druid level (rounded up), and none of the slots can be 6th level or higher.

subclasses.name: Circle of the Moon
subclasses.description: Druids who are fierce guardians of the wilds, specializing in Wild Shape to take on powerful beast forms.

features.name: Combat Wild Shape
features.description: You can use Wild Shape as a bonus action rather than an action. Additionally, while transformed, you can expend a spell slot to regain 1d8 hit points per level of the spell slot.

features.name: Circle Forms
features.description: You can transform into a beast with a challenge rating as high as 1 (at 2nd level, increasing at higher levels), ignoring the normal Wild Shape CR limitations.

subclasses.name: Circle of the Shepherd
subclasses.description: Druids who commune with the spirits of nature to call upon animal allies and protect the beasts of the wild.

features.name: Spirit Totem
features.description: As a bonus action, you can summon an incorporeal spirit to a point within 60 feet. The spirit creates a 30-foot aura: Bear Spirit (temporary HP and advantage on Strength checks), Hawk Spirit (advantage on ranged attacks), or Unicorn Spirit (advantage on detecting creatures, healing bonus).

features.name: Speech of the Woods
features.description: You gain the ability to converse with beasts as if you shared a language, and you learn Sylvan.

subclasses.name: Circle of Spores
subclasses.description: Druids who see beauty in decay, harnessing the power of fungi, mold, and spores.

features.name: Halo of Spores
features.description: Invisible necrotic spores surround you. When a creature you can see moves into a space within 10 feet of you or starts its turn there, you can use your reaction to deal 1d4 necrotic damage if it fails a Constitution saving throw.

features.name: Symbiotic Entity
features.description: As an action, you can expend a use of Wild Shape to gain 4 temporary HP per druid level, double your Halo of Spores damage, and deal an extra 1d6 necrotic damage with melee weapon attacks. Lasts for 10 minutes.

subclasses.name: Circle of Stars
subclasses.description: Druids who draw on the power of starlight, tracking celestial patterns to guide their magic.

features.name: Star Map
features.description: You've created a star chart that serves as your spellcasting focus. While holding it, you know the guidance cantrip and have guiding bolt always prepared, which doesn't count against your prepared spells.

features.name: Starry Form
features.description: As a bonus action, you can expend a use of Wild Shape to assume a starry form for 10 minutes: Archer (bonus action ranged attack), Chalice (bonus healing when casting a healing spell), or Dragon (minimum 10 on concentration checks and hover).

subclasses.name: Circle of Wildfire
subclasses.description: Druids who understand the necessity of destruction for new growth, wielding fire as both a creative and destructive force.

features.name: Summon Wildfire Spirit
features.description: You can expend one use of Wild Shape to summon your wildfire spirit rather than transform. The spirit appears within 30 feet and each creature within 10 feet of it must make a Dexterity saving throw or take 2d6 fire damage.

features.name: Enhanced Bond
features.description: The bond with your wildfire spirit enhances your spells. When you cast a spell that deals fire damage or restores hit points while your spirit is summoned, roll a d8 and add the result to one roll of the spell.

name: Fighter
description: A master of martial combat, skilled with a variety of weapons and armor. Fighters learn the basics of all combat styles, gaining broad capability with weapons and armor.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: You adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty. Choose one fighting style such as Archery, Defense, Dueling, Great Weapon Fighting, Protection, or Two-Weapon Fighting.

features.name: Second Wind
features.description: You have a limited well of stamina that you can draw on. On your turn, you can use a bonus action to regain hit points equal to 1d10 + your fighter level. Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again.

features.name: Action Surge
features.description: You can push yourself beyond your normal limits for a moment. On your turn, you can take one additional action. Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn. The number of attacks increases to three at 11th level and to four at 20th level.

features.name: Indomitable
features.description: You can reroll a saving throw that you fail. If you do so, you must use the new roll. You can use this feature once, increasing to twice at 13th level and three times at 17th level.

subclasses.name: Arcane Archer
subclasses.description: Fighters who infuse their arrows with magic to produce supernatural effects on the battlefield.

features.name: Arcane Shot
features.description: You learn two Arcane Shot options of your choice. Once per turn when you fire a magic arrow from a shortbow or longbow as part of the Attack action, you can apply one Arcane Shot option to that arrow. You have two uses, regained on a short or long rest.

features.name: Magic Arrow
features.description: Whenever you fire a nonmagical arrow from a shortbow or longbow, you can make it magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.

subclasses.name: Banneret (Purple Dragon Knight)
subclasses.description: Knights who inspire greatness in others by committing brave deeds and rallying their allies.

features.name: Rallying Cry
features.description: When you use your Second Wind feature, you can choose up to three creatures within 60 feet of you that are allied to you. Each one regains hit points equal to your fighter level.

features.name: Royal Envoy
features.description: You gain proficiency in the Persuasion skill. If you are already proficient, you gain proficiency in one of the following: Animal Handling, Insight, Intimidation, or Performance. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for Persuasion checks.

subclasses.name: Battle Master
subclasses.description: Fighters who employ martial techniques passed down through generations, using superiority dice to fuel powerful maneuvers.

features.name: Combat Superiority
features.description: You learn three maneuvers of your choice (such as Trip Attack, Riposte, or Precision Attack). You have four superiority dice (d8s). A superiority die is expended when you use a maneuver. You regain all expended superiority dice on a short or long rest.

features.name: Student of War
features.description: You gain proficiency with one type of artisan's tools of your choice.

subclasses.name: Cavalier
subclasses.description: Fighters who excel at mounted combat and protecting allies, serving as unwavering sentinels.

features.name: Unwavering Mark
features.description: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can mark the creature until the end of your next turn. A marked creature has disadvantage on any attack roll against a target other than you, and you can make a special melee attack as a bonus action if it deals damage to anyone other than you.

features.name: Born to the Saddle
features.description: You have advantage on saving throws made to avoid falling off your mount. If you fall off, you land on your feet if you're not incapacitated, and mounting or dismounting costs only 5 feet of movement.

subclasses.name: Champion
subclasses.description: Fighters who focus on the development of raw physical power honed to deadly perfection.

features.name: Improved Critical
features.description: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

features.name: Remarkable Athlete
features.description: You can add half your proficiency bonus (rounded up) to any Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution check you make that doesn't already use your proficiency bonus. In addition, when you make a running long jump, the distance you can cover increases by a number of feet equal to your Strength modifier.

subclasses.name: Echo Knight
subclasses.description: Fighters who manifest echoes of themselves from unrealized timelines to fight alongside them.

features.name: Manifest Echo
features.description: As a bonus action, you can magically manifest an echo of yourself in an unoccupied space within 15 feet. You can make attacks from the echo's position and swap places with it using 15 feet of movement.

features.name: Unleash Incarnation
features.description: When you take the Attack action, you can make one additional melee attack from the echo's position. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier per long rest.

subclasses.name: Eldritch Knight
subclasses.description: Fighters who combine martial prowess with arcane magic, learning to cast wizard spells while wielding weapons.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You learn two wizard cantrips and three 1st-level wizard spells (two must be abjuration or evocation). Intelligence is your spellcasting ability.

features.name: Weapon Bond
features.description: You learn a ritual to bond with a weapon. Once bonded, you can't be disarmed of that weapon unless incapacitated. You can summon it to your hand as a bonus action if it is on the same plane.

subclasses.name: Psi Warrior
subclasses.description: Fighters who awaken psionic power within themselves, augmenting their physical might with telekinetic abilities.

features.name: Psionic Power
features.description: You have a pool of psionic energy dice (d6s) equal to twice your proficiency bonus. You can expend them to use Protective Field (reduce damage as a reaction), Psionic Strike (add force damage to attacks), or Telekinetic Movement (move objects or creatures).

features.name: Telekinetic Adept
features.description: You can use your Psi Warrior abilities with greater versatility, including the ability to fly and create a telekinetic thrust that moves creatures.

subclasses.name: Rune Knight
subclasses.description: Fighters who study the giant's art of runecraft, inscribing magical runes on their equipment.

features.name: Rune Carver
features.description: You learn two runes of your choice (such as Cloud, Fire, Frost, Stone, Hill, or Storm). You can inscribe each rune onto a weapon, armor, or shield, gaining passive benefits and the ability to invoke the rune for a powerful effect once per short or long rest.

features.name: Giant's Might
features.description: As a bonus action, you magically gain benefits for 1 minute: you become Large (if smaller), have advantage on Strength checks and saving throws, and deal 1d6 extra damage once per turn on a weapon attack.

subclasses.name: Samurai
subclasses.description: Fighters who draw on an implacable fighting spirit to overcome enemies through sheer determination.

features.name: Fighting Spirit
features.description: As a bonus action, you can give yourself advantage on weapon attack rolls until the end of the current turn. When you do so, you also gain 5 temporary hit points. You can use this feature three times per long rest.

features.name: Elegant Courtier
features.description: You gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws. If you already have this proficiency, you gain proficiency in Intelligence or Charisma saving throws instead. You also add your Wisdom modifier to Charisma (Persuasion) checks.

name: Monk
description: A master of martial arts, harnessing the power of the body in pursuit of physical and spiritual perfection, using ki to fuel extraordinary abilities.
tool_proficiencies: One type of artisan's tools or one musical instrument

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.description: While you are wearing no armor and not wielding a shield, your AC equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Martial Arts
features.description: Your practice of martial arts gives you mastery of combat styles that use unarmed strikes and monk weapons. You gain benefits: use Dexterity for attack and damage of unarmed strikes and monk weapons, roll a d4 in place of the normal damage (increasing at higher levels), and make one unarmed strike as a bonus action after an Attack action.

features.name: Ki
features.description: Your training allows you to harness the mystic energy of ki. You have a number of ki points equal to your monk level. You can spend ki points to fuel Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, or Step of the Wind.

features.name: Unarmored Movement
features.description: Your speed increases by 10 feet while you are not wearing armor or wielding a shield. This bonus increases at higher levels.

features.name: Stunning Strike
features.description: When you hit another creature with a melee weapon attack, you can spend 1 ki point to attempt a stunning strike. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of your next turn.

subclasses.name: Way of Mercy
subclasses.description: Monks who learn to manipulate the life force of others to heal the wounded or bring swift end to the dying.

features.name: Hands of Healing
features.description: As an action, you can spend 1 ki point to touch a creature and restore a number of hit points equal to a roll of your Martial Arts die + your Wisdom modifier. When you use Flurry of Blows, you can replace one of the unarmed strikes with a use of this feature without spending a ki point.

features.name: Hands of Harm
features.description: When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike, you can spend 1 ki point to deal extra necrotic damage equal to one roll of your Martial Arts die + your Wisdom modifier.

subclasses.name: Way of the Ascendant Dragon
subclasses.description: Monks who channel draconic power through their ki, manifesting breath weapons and spectral wings.

features.name: Draconic Disciple
features.description: You can channel draconic power to augment your presence and change the damage type of your unarmed strikes to acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison.

features.name: Breath of the Dragon
features.description: You can spend 1 ki point to use your action to exhale draconic energy in a 20-foot cone or 30-foot line. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw or take damage equal to two rolls of your Martial Arts die.

subclasses.name: Way of the Astral Self
subclasses.description: Monks who believe their ki is a connection to the astral plane, manifesting a spectral astral self.

features.name: Arms of the Astral Self
features.description: As a bonus action, you can spend 1 ki point to summon the arms of your astral self for 10 minutes. Each creature of your choice within 10 feet must make a Dexterity saving throw or take force damage. While active, you can use Wisdom for unarmed strike attack and damage rolls, and your reach increases by 5 feet.

features.name: Visage of the Astral Self
features.description: You can spend 1 ki point to summon the visage of your astral self, gaining darkvision, advantage on Insight and Intimidation checks, and the ability to speak to creatures within 60 feet that can hear you without sound.

subclasses.name: Way of the Drunken Master
subclasses.description: Monks who use the erratic, unpredictable movements of a drunkard, swaying and staggering to avoid attacks.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency in the Performance skill and with brewer's supplies.

features.name: Drunken Technique
features.description: When you use Flurry of Blows, you gain the benefit of the Disengage action, and your walking speed increases by 10 feet until the end of the current turn.

subclasses.name: Way of the Four Elements
subclasses.description: Monks who harness the power of the four elements — earth, water, fire, and air — channeling ki into elemental spells.

features.name: Disciple of the Elements
features.description: You learn magical disciplines that harness the power of the four elements. You learn the Elemental Attunement discipline and one other of your choice, such as Fangs of the Fire Snake, Fist of Unbroken Air, or Water Whip.

features.name: Elemental Attunement
features.description: You can use your action to briefly control elemental forces, creating minor sensory effects like a puff of wind, a spark, a flow of pebbles, or a brief flash of steam.

subclasses.name: Way of the Kensei
subclasses.description: Monks who see weapons as extensions of their body, treating each weapon as a brush to paint their martial artistry.

features.name: Path of the Kensei
features.description: You choose two types of weapons to be your kensei weapons (one melee, one ranged). You gain proficiency with these weapons if you don't already have it, and they become monk weapons for you.

features.name: Agile Parry
features.description: If you make an unarmed strike as part of the Attack action on your turn and are holding a kensei weapon, you can use it to defend yourself, gaining +2 to AC until the start of your next turn while holding the weapon and aren't incapacitated.

subclasses.name: Way of the Long Death
subclasses.description: Monks obsessed with the meaning and mechanics of dying, using dark knowledge of death to empower themselves.

features.name: Touch of Death
features.description: When you reduce a creature within 5 feet of you to 0 hit points, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Wisdom modifier + your monk level.

features.name: Hour of Reaping
features.description: As an action, each creature within 30 feet of you that can see you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of you until the end of your next turn.

subclasses.name: Way of the Open Hand
subclasses.description: Monks who are the ultimate masters of martial arts combat, refining unarmed strikes into powerful finishing techniques.

features.name: Open Hand Technique
features.description: When you hit a creature with one of the attacks granted by your Flurry of Blows, you can impose one of three effects: it must succeed on a Dexterity save or be knocked prone, it must make a Strength save or be pushed up to 15 feet away, or it can't take reactions until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Wholeness of Body
features.description: You gain the ability to heal yourself. As an action, you can regain hit points equal to three times your monk level. You must finish a long rest before you can use this feature again.

subclasses.name: Way of Shadow
subclasses.description: Monks who follow a tradition that values stealth and subterfuge, moving through shadows and striking unseen.

features.name: Shadow Arts
features.description: You can use your ki to duplicate the effects of certain spells. As an action, you can spend 2 ki points to cast darkness, darkvision, pass without trace, or silence. You also learn the minor illusion cantrip.

features.name: Shadow Step
features.description: When you are in dim light or darkness, as a bonus action you can teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see that is also in dim light or darkness. You then have advantage on the first melee attack you make before the end of the turn.

subclasses.name: Way of the Sun Soul
subclasses.description: Monks who learn to channel their own life energy into searing bolts of light, becoming radiant warrior-monks.

features.name: Radiant Sun Bolt
features.description: You gain a new attack option that you can use with the Attack action. This special attack is a ranged spell attack with a range of 30 feet. You are proficient with it, and you add your Dexterity modifier to its attack and damage rolls. Its damage is radiant, and its damage die is a d4 (this die changes as you gain monk levels).

features.name: Searing Arc Strike
features.description: Immediately after you take the Attack action on your turn, you can spend 2 ki points to cast burning hands as a bonus action.

name: Paladin
description: A holy warrior bound to a sacred oath, combining martial prowess with divine magic to smite evil and protect the innocent.

features.name: Divine Sense
features.description: As an action, you can detect the presence of any celestial, fiend, or undead within 60 feet that is not behind total cover. You can use this feature a number of times equal to 1 + your Charisma modifier per long rest.

features.name: Lay on Hands
features.description: You have a pool of healing power equal to your paladin level x 5. As an action, you can touch a creature and restore any number of hit points from this pool, or spend 5 hit points to cure one disease or neutralize one poison.

features.name: Divine Smite
features.description: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can expend one spell slot to deal radiant damage to the target, in addition to the weapon's damage. The extra damage is 2d8 for a 1st-level slot, plus 1d8 for each slot level higher than 1st, to a maximum of 5d8. The damage increases by 1d8 if the target is an undead or a fiend.

features.name: Aura of Protection
features.description: Whenever you or a friendly creature within 10 feet of you must make a saving throw, the creature gains a bonus to the saving throw equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of +1). You must be conscious to grant this bonus.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

subclasses.name: Oath of the Ancients
subclasses.description: Paladins who swear to protect the light against the darkness, preserving beauty, love, and joy in the world.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Nature's Wrath
features.description: You can use your Channel Divinity to invoke primeval forces to ensnare a foe. As an action, spectral vines spring up around a creature within 10 feet, which must succeed on a Strength or Dexterity saving throw or be restrained.

features.name: Aura of Warding
features.description: You and friendly creatures within 10 feet of you have resistance to damage from spells.

subclasses.name: Oath of Conquest
subclasses.description: Paladins who seek glory in battle and the subjugation of their enemies, ruling through strength and fear.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Conquering Presence
features.description: You can use your Channel Divinity to exude a terrifying presence. As an action, each creature of your choice within 30 feet must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of you for 1 minute.

features.name: Aura of Conquest
features.description: Creatures that are frightened of you have their speed reduced to 0 while in your aura (10 feet) and take psychic damage equal to half your paladin level at the start of their turn.

subclasses.name: Oath of the Crown
subclasses.description: Paladins who swear to serve society, the law, and the sovereign, standing as sentinels against chaos.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Champion Challenge
features.description: You issue a challenge. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature can't willingly move more than 30 feet away from you.

features.name: Divine Allegiance
features.description: When a creature within 5 feet of you takes damage, you can use your reaction to magically substitute your own health for that of the target creature, taking the damage instead.

subclasses.name: Oath of Devotion
subclasses.description: Paladins bound to the loftiest ideals of justice, virtue, and order, serving as beacons of hope.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Sacred Weapon
features.description: As an action, you imbue one weapon you are holding with positive energy. For 1 minute, you add your Charisma modifier to attack rolls made with that weapon (minimum bonus of +1). The weapon also emits bright light in a 20-foot radius.

features.name: Aura of Devotion
features.description: You and friendly creatures within 10 feet of you can't be charmed while you are conscious.

subclasses.name: Oath of Glory
subclasses.description: Paladins who train diligently and encourage their companions to push beyond their physical limits.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Peerless Athlete
features.description: As a bonus action, you can use your Channel Divinity to augment your athleticism. For 10 minutes, you have advantage on Athletics and Acrobatics checks, and your carrying, push, drag, and lift capacity doubles. You can also jump 10 extra feet.

features.name: Aura of Alacrity
features.description: Your walking speed increases by 10 feet. In addition, if you aren't incapacitated, the walking speed of any ally who starts their turn within 5 feet of you increases by 10 feet until the end of that turn.

subclasses.name: Oath of Redemption
subclasses.description: Paladins who believe that any creature can be redeemed and are dedicated to peace and patience.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Emissary of Peace
features.description: You can use your Channel Divinity to augment your presence with divine power. As a bonus action, you grant yourself a +5 bonus to Charisma (Persuasion) checks for the next 10 minutes.

features.name: Aura of the Guardian
features.description: You can shield your allies from harm. When a creature within 10 feet of you takes damage, you can use your reaction to magically take that damage instead.

subclasses.name: Oath of Vengeance
subclasses.description: Paladins who swear an oath to punish those who have committed grievous sins, focusing their fury against the wicked.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Vow of Enmity
features.description: As a bonus action, you can utter a vow of enmity against a creature you can see within 10 feet. You gain advantage on attack rolls against the creature for 1 minute or until it drops to 0 hit points or falls unconscious.

features.name: Relentless Avenger
features.description: When you hit a creature with an opportunity attack, you can move up to half your speed immediately after the attack and as part of the same reaction. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

subclasses.name: Oath of the Watchers
subclasses.description: Paladins who swear to safeguard the mortal realm from extraplanar threats, standing vigilant against otherworldly incursions.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Watcher's Will
features.description: You can use your Channel Divinity to invest your presence with the warding power of your oath. As an action, choose a number of creatures you can see within 30 feet equal to your Charisma modifier. For 1 minute, you and the chosen creatures have advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

features.name: Aura of the Sentinel
features.description: You emit an aura of alertness. When you and any creatures of your choice within 10 feet roll initiative, you each gain a bonus to initiative equal to your proficiency bonus.

subclasses.name: Oathbreaker
subclasses.description: Paladins who have broken their sacred oaths to pursue some dark ambition or serve an evil power, gaining dark abilities.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Control Undead
features.description: As an action, you target one undead creature within 30 feet. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the creature must obey your commands for the next 24 hours.

features.name: Aura of Hate
features.description: You and any fiends and undead within 10 feet of you gain a bonus to melee weapon damage rolls equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of +1).

name: Ranger
description: A warrior who combats threats on the edges of civilization, using martial prowess and nature magic to hunt the monsters that threaten civilization.

features.name: Favored Enemy
features.description: You have significant experience studying, tracking, hunting, and even talking to a certain type of enemy. Choose a type of favored enemy. You have advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to track your favored enemies, as well as on Intelligence checks to recall information about them.

features.name: Natural Explorer
features.description: You are particularly familiar with one type of natural environment and are adept at traveling and surviving in such regions. When you make an Intelligence or Wisdom check related to your favored terrain, your proficiency bonus is doubled.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: You adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty. Choose one: Archery, Defense, Dueling, or Two-Weapon Fighting.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You have learned to use the magical essence of nature to cast spells, much as a druid does. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

subclasses.name: Beast Master
subclasses.description: Rangers who forge a mystical bond with a beast companion, fighting and traveling together as partners.

features.name: Ranger's Companion
features.description: You gain a beast companion that accompanies you on your adventures and is trained to fight alongside you. Choose a beast that is no larger than Medium and that has a challenge rating of 1/4 or lower. It obeys your commands and takes its turn on your initiative.

features.name: Exceptional Training
features.description: On any of your turns when your beast companion doesn't attack, you can use a bonus action to command the beast to take the Dash, Disengage, or Help action on its turn. Its attacks now count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks.

subclasses.name: Drakewarden
subclasses.description: Rangers who form a bond with a drake, a small draconic companion that grows in power alongside them.

features.name: Draconic Gift
features.description: You learn the thaumaturgy cantrip, and you can speak, read, and write Draconic. You can also use this connection to manifest a Drake Companion.

features.name: Drake Companion
features.description: As an action, you can summon a small drake companion in an unoccupied space within 30 feet. The drake's bond to you strengthens as you gain levels, growing in size, power, and abilities.

subclasses.name: Fey Wanderer
subclasses.description: Rangers who have been touched by the Feywild, gaining fey magic and an otherworldly charm.

features.name: Dreadful Strikes
features.description: You can augment your weapon strikes with mind-scarring magic. Once per turn when you hit a creature with a weapon, you can deal an extra 1d4 psychic damage to the target.

features.name: Otherworldly Glamour
features.description: You can add your Wisdom modifier to any Charisma check you make, and you gain proficiency in one of the following skills: Deception, Performance, or Persuasion.

subclasses.name: Gloom Stalker
subclasses.description: Rangers who are at home in the darkest places, striking from the shadows with deadly efficiency.

features.name: Dread Ambusher
features.description: At the start of your first turn of each combat, your walking speed increases by 10 feet until the end of that turn. If you take the Attack action on that turn, you can make one additional weapon attack, dealing an extra 1d8 damage on a hit.

features.name: Umbral Sight
features.description: You gain darkvision out to a range of 60 feet (or your existing darkvision increases by 30 feet). You are also invisible to any creature that relies on darkvision to see you in the darkness.

subclasses.name: Horizon Walker
subclasses.description: Rangers who guard the world against threats that originate from other planes, able to detect and travel through planar portals.

features.name: Detect Portal
features.description: As an action, you detect the distance and direction to the closest planar portal within 1 mile of you. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier per long rest.

features.name: Planar Warrior
features.description: As a bonus action, choose one creature you can see within 30 feet. The next time you hit that creature on this turn with a weapon attack, all damage dealt by the attack becomes force damage, and the creature takes an extra 1d8 force damage.

subclasses.name: Hunter
subclasses.description: Rangers who accept the challenge of defending civilization from the terrors of the wilderness, mastering specialized combat techniques.

features.name: Hunter's Prey
features.description: Choose one of three features: Colossus Slayer (1d8 extra damage to wounded creatures once per turn), Giant Killer (reaction attack when a Large or larger creature within 5 feet attacks you), or Horde Breaker (make an additional attack against a different creature within 5 feet of the original target).

features.name: Defensive Tactics
features.description: Choose one: Escape the Horde (opportunity attacks have disadvantage against you), Multiattack Defense (+4 AC after being hit by a multiattack creature), or Steel Will (advantage on saves against being frightened).

subclasses.name: Monster Slayer
subclasses.description: Rangers dedicated to hunting and destroying creatures of the night and wielders of dark magic.

features.name: Hunter's Sense
features.description: As an action, choose one creature you can see within 60 feet. You immediately learn whether the creature has any damage immunities, resistances, or vulnerabilities and what they are.

features.name: Slayer's Prey
features.description: As a bonus action, designate one creature you can see within 60 feet as your prey. The first time each turn that you hit that target with a weapon attack, it takes an extra 1d6 damage. This lasts until you finish a short or long rest.

subclasses.name: Swarmkeeper
subclasses.description: Rangers who have bonded with a swarm of nature spirits, commanding them to aid in combat and exploration.

features.name: Gathered Swarm
features.description: A swarm of intangible nature spirits bonds with you. Once per turn when you hit a creature with an attack, the swarm can deal 1d6 piercing damage, move the creature 15 feet horizontally, or move you 5 feet horizontally.

features.name: Swarmkeeper Magic
features.description: You learn the mage hand cantrip. You also learn additional spells at certain levels: faerie fire, web, gaseous form, arcane eye, and insect plague.

name: Rogue
description: A scoundrel who uses stealth and trickery to overcome obstacles and enemies, relying on skill, stealth, and their foes' vulnerabilities to get the upper hand.

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.description: Once per turn, you can deal an extra 1d6 damage to one creature you hit with an attack if you have advantage on the attack roll, or if another enemy of the target is within 5 feet of it. The extra damage increases as you gain levels.

features.name: Thieves' Cant
features.description: You have learned thieves' cant, a secret mix of dialect, jargon, and code that allows you to hide messages in seemingly normal conversation.

features.name: Cunning Action
features.description: You can take a bonus action on each of your turns in combat to Dash, Disengage, or Hide.

features.name: Uncanny Dodge
features.description: When an attacker that you can see hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to halve the attack's damage against you.

features.name: Evasion
features.description: When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if you fail.

subclasses.name: Arcane Trickster
subclasses.description: Rogues who enhance their fine-honed skills of stealth and agility with magic, learning wizard spells.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You gain the ability to cast wizard spells. You learn three cantrips (including mage hand) and three 1st-level wizard spells (two must be enchantment or illusion). Intelligence is your spellcasting ability.

features.name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
features.description: When you cast mage hand, you can make the spectral hand invisible, and you can stow or retrieve an object from a container worn or carried by another creature, use thieves' tools to pick locks or disarm traps at range, or plant objects.

subclasses.name: Assassin
subclasses.description: Rogues who focus on the grim art of death, using stealth, poison, and disguise to eliminate targets.

features.name: Assassinate
features.description: You are at your deadliest when you get the drop on your enemies. You have advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn in the combat yet. In addition, any hit you score against a creature that is surprised is a critical hit.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency with the disguise kit and the poisoner's kit.

subclasses.name: Inquisitive
subclasses.description: Rogues who excel at rooting out secrets and unraveling mysteries, using keen observation to find hidden truths.

features.name: Ear for Deceit
features.description: You develop a talent for picking out lies. Whenever you make a Wisdom (Insight) check to determine whether a creature is lying, treat a roll of 7 or lower on the d20 as an 8.

features.name: Eye for Detail
features.description: As a bonus action, you can make a Wisdom (Perception) check to spot a hidden creature or object or make an Intelligence (Investigation) check to uncover or decipher clues.

subclasses.name: Mastermind
subclasses.description: Rogues who excel at manipulating others, serving as spymasters, courtiers, and schemers.

features.name: Master of Intrigue
features.description: You gain proficiency with the disguise kit, the forgery kit, and one gaming set of your choice. You also learn two languages of your choice. You can unerringly mimic the speech patterns and accent of a creature that you hear speak for at least 1 minute.

features.name: Master of Tactics
features.description: You can use the Help action as a bonus action. When you use the Help action to aid an ally in attacking a creature, the target of that attack can be within 30 feet of you, rather than within 5 feet.

subclasses.name: Phantom
subclasses.description: Rogues who have a mystical connection to death, able to walk the line between life and death.

features.name: Whispers of the Dead
features.description: When you finish a short or long rest, you can gain one skill or tool proficiency of your choice, as a ghostly presence shares its knowledge with you. You lose this proficiency when you use this feature to choose a different proficiency.

features.name: Wails from the Grave
features.description: When you deal Sneak Attack damage to a creature, you can target a second creature within 30 feet of the first and deal half the number of Sneak Attack damage dice in necrotic damage to it.

subclasses.name: Scout
subclasses.description: Rogues who are skilled in stealth and surviving far from the streets of a city, serving as explorers, spies, and ambushers.

features.name: Skirmisher
features.description: You can move up to half your speed as a reaction when an enemy ends its turn within 5 feet of you. This movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.

features.name: Survivalist
features.description: You gain proficiency in the Nature and Survival skills. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of those proficiencies.

subclasses.name: Soulknife
subclasses.description: Rogues who manifest psionic blades of psychic energy to cut through both physical and mental defenses.

features.name: Psionic Power
features.description: You have a pool of Psionic Energy dice (d6) equal to twice your proficiency bonus. You can use them for Psi-Bolstered Knack (add to failed ability checks) and Psychic Whispers (telepathic communication).

features.name: Psychic Blades
features.description: You can manifest a blade of psychic energy from your free hand. The magic blade deals 1d6 psychic damage and has the finesse and thrown properties (range 60 feet). After attacking with the blade, you can make a bonus action attack with a second psychic blade dealing 1d4 psychic damage.

subclasses.name: Swashbuckler
subclasses.description: Rogues who combine charm and elegance with combat skill, fighting with panache and confidence.

features.name: Fancy Footwork
features.description: During your turn, if you make a melee attack against a creature, that creature can't make opportunity attacks against you for the rest of your turn.

features.name: Rakish Audacity
features.description: You can add your Charisma modifier to your initiative rolls. You also gain Sneak Attack against a creature if you are within 5 feet of it and no other creature is within 5 feet of you, even without advantage.

subclasses.name: Thief
subclasses.description: Rogues who hone their skills in the larcenous arts, becoming expert burglars, dungeon delvers, and treasure hunters.

features.name: Fast Hands
features.description: You can use the bonus action granted by your Cunning Action to make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check, use your thieves' tools to disarm a trap or open a lock, or take the Use an Object action.

features.name: Second-Story Work
features.description: You gain the ability to climb faster than normal; climbing no longer costs you extra movement. In addition, when you make a running jump, the distance you cover increases by a number of feet equal to your Dexterity modifier.

name: Sorcerer
description: A spellcaster who draws on inherent magic from a gift or bloodline, wielding raw magical power that can be shaped through force of will.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: An event in your past, or in the life of a parent or ancestor, left an indelible mark on you, infusing you with arcane magic. Charisma is your spellcasting ability.

features.name: Sorcerous Origin
features.description: Choose a sorcerous origin, which describes the source of your innate magical power. Your choice grants you features at 1st level and again at 6th, 14th, and 18th level.

features.name: Font of Magic
features.description: You tap into a deep wellspring of magic within yourself. You have sorcery points equal to your sorcerer level. You can use sorcery points to gain additional spell slots, or sacrifice spell slots to gain additional sorcery points.

features.name: Metamagic
features.description: You gain the ability to twist your spells to suit your needs. You gain two Metamagic options of your choice (such as Twinned Spell, Quickened Spell, or Subtle Spell). You can use only one Metamagic option on a spell when you cast it, unless otherwise noted.

subclasses.name: Aberrant Mind
subclasses.description: Sorcerers whose power derives from alien influence, granting telepathic abilities and psionic spells.

features.name: Psionic Spells
features.description: You learn additional spells (arms of Hadar, dissonant whispers, mind sliver) that don't count against your number of sorcerer spells known. These spells count as sorcerer spells for you.

features.name: Telepathic Speech
features.description: You can form a telepathic connection with one creature within 30 feet. For a number of minutes equal to your sorcerer level, you and the target can speak telepathically with each other.

subclasses.name: Clockwork Soul
subclasses.description: Sorcerers whose power is linked to the plane of Mechanus, channeling cosmic order to restore balance.

features.name: Clockwork Magic
features.description: You learn additional spells (alarm, protection from evil and good) that don't count against your number of sorcerer spells known. Whenever you gain a sorcerer level, you can replace one of these with an abjuration or transmutation spell.

features.name: Restore Balance
features.description: When a creature you can see within 60 feet is about to roll a d20 with advantage or disadvantage, you can use your reaction to prevent the roll from being affected by advantage and disadvantage. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

subclasses.name: Draconic Bloodline
subclasses.description: Sorcerers whose magic comes from draconic ancestry, gaining dragon-like resilience and elemental power.

features.name: Dragon Ancestor
features.description: You choose one type of dragon as your ancestor. You can speak, read, and write Draconic, and whenever you make a Charisma check when interacting with dragons, your proficiency bonus is doubled.

features.name: Draconic Resilience
features.description: As magic flows through your body, it causes physical traits of your dragon ancestors to emerge. Your hit point maximum increases by 1 for each sorcerer level, and when you aren't wearing armor, your AC equals 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

subclasses.name: Divine Soul
subclasses.description: Sorcerers blessed with divine magic, able to learn cleric spells and channel celestial or infernal power.

features.name: Divine Magic
features.description: Your link to the divine allows you to learn spells from the cleric spell list in addition to the sorcerer spell list. When your Spellcasting feature lets you learn or replace a sorcerer cantrip or a sorcerer spell, you can choose the new spell from the cleric spell list or the sorcerer spell list.

features.name: Favored by the Gods
features.description: If you fail a saving throw or miss with an attack roll, you can roll 2d4 and add it to the total, possibly changing the outcome. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

subclasses.name: Lunar Sorcery
subclasses.description: Sorcerers who draw their power from the moon, shifting between lunar phases to access different magical abilities.

features.name: Moon Fire
features.description: You learn the sacred flame cantrip, which doesn't count against the number of sorcerer cantrips you know. When you cast it, you can target one or two creatures within range.

features.name: Lunar Embodiment
features.description: You attune to a lunar phase (Full Moon, New Moon, or Crescent Moon), each granting a set of bonus spells. You can change your phase at the end of a long rest.

subclasses.name: Shadow Magic
subclasses.description: Sorcerers who draw their power from the Shadowfell, gaining dark abilities and the power to cheat death.

features.name: Eyes of the Dark
features.description: You have darkvision with a range of 120 feet. At 3rd level, you learn the darkness spell, which doesn't count against your number of sorcerer spells known. You can cast it by spending 2 sorcery points or a spell slot, and if cast with sorcery points, you can see through the darkness.

features.name: Strength of the Grave
features.description: When damage reduces you to 0 hit points, you can make a Charisma saving throw (DC 5 + the damage taken). On a success, you instead drop to 1 hit point. You can't use this feature if you are reduced to 0 hit points by radiant damage or by a critical hit.

subclasses.name: Storm Sorcery
subclasses.description: Sorcerers whose magic comes from the power of elemental air and storms, crackling with lightning.

features.name: Wind Speaker
features.description: You can speak, read, and write Primordial. Knowing Primordial allows you to understand and be understood by those who speak its dialects: Aquan, Auran, Ignan, and Terran.

features.name: Tempestuous Magic
features.description: When you cast a spell of 1st level or higher, you can use a bonus action to cause whirling gusts of elemental air to briefly surround you, allowing you to fly up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

subclasses.name: Wild Magic
subclasses.description: Sorcerers whose innate magic comes from the wild forces of chaos, producing unpredictable surges of power.

features.name: Wild Magic Surge
features.description: Once per turn, the DM can have you roll a d20 immediately after you cast a sorcerer spell of 1st level or higher. If you roll a 1, roll on the Wild Magic Surge table to create a random magical effect.

features.name: Tides of Chaos
features.description: You can manipulate the forces of chance and chaos to gain advantage on one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. Once you do so, you must finish a long rest before you can use this feature again (unless a Wild Magic Surge occurs, which restores it).

name: Warlock
description: A wielder of magic derived from a bargain with an extraplanar entity, gaining eldritch power through a pact with a powerful patron.

features.name: Otherworldly Patron
features.description: You have struck a bargain with an otherworldly being of your choice. Your choice grants you features at 1st level and again at 6th, 10th, and 14th level.

features.name: Pact Magic
features.description: Your arcane research and the magic bestowed on you by your patron have given you facility with spells. Charisma is your spellcasting ability. You have a limited number of spell slots that recharge on a short rest and are always cast at your highest available slot level.

features.name: Eldritch Invocations
features.description: In your study of occult lore, you have unearthed eldritch invocations, fragments of forbidden knowledge that imbue you with an abiding magical ability. You gain two eldritch invocations of your choice (such as Agonizing Blast, Mask of Many Faces, or Devil's Sight).

features.name: Pact Boon
features.description: Your otherworldly patron bestows a gift upon you for your loyal service. Choose one: Pact of the Chain (find familiar), Pact of the Blade (create a pact weapon), Pact of the Tome (Book of Shadows with three cantrips), or Pact of the Talisman (bonus to failed ability checks).

features.name: Mystic Arcanum
features.description: Your patron bestows upon you a magical secret called an arcanum. Choose one 6th-level spell from the warlock spell list as this arcanum. You can cast it once without expending a spell slot, regaining the ability to do so when you finish a long rest.

subclasses.name: The Archfey
subclasses.description: Warlocks bound to a lord or lady of the fey, gaining enchanting and illusory powers from the Feywild.

features.name: Fey Presence
features.description: As an action, you can cause each creature in a 10-foot cube originating from you to make a Wisdom saving throw. The creatures that fail are charmed or frightened by you (your choice) until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Misty Escape
features.description: When you take damage, you can use your reaction to turn invisible and teleport up to 60 feet. You remain invisible until the start of your next turn or until you attack or cast a spell.

subclasses.name: The Celestial
subclasses.description: Warlocks whose patron is a powerful being of the Upper Planes, granting healing abilities and radiant magic.

features.name: Healing Light
features.description: You gain a pool of d6s equal to 1 + your warlock level. As a bonus action, you can heal a creature within 60 feet, spending dice from the pool. The maximum number of dice you can spend at once equals your Charisma modifier.

features.name: Radiant Soul
features.description: You gain resistance to radiant damage, and when you cast a spell that deals radiant or fire damage, you can add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll of that spell against one of its targets.

subclasses.name: The Fathomless
subclasses.description: Warlocks who forge a pact with an entity of the deep ocean, gaining aquatic powers and spectral tentacles.

features.name: Tentacle of the Deeps
features.description: You can magically summon a spectral tentacle that strikes at your foes. As a bonus action, you create a 10-foot-long tentacle at a point you can see within 60 feet. When you create it and as a bonus action on subsequent turns, you can make a melee spell attack dealing 1d8 cold damage and reducing the target's speed by 10 feet.

features.name: Gift of the Sea
features.description: You gain a swimming speed of 40 feet, and you can breathe underwater.

subclasses.name: The Fiend
subclasses.description: Warlocks who make a pact with a fiend from the lower planes of existence, gaining destructive power and resilience.

features.name: Dark One's Blessing
features.description: When you reduce a hostile creature to 0 hit points, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier + your warlock level.

features.name: Dark One's Own Luck
features.description: When you make an ability check or a saving throw, you can add a d10 to your roll. You can do so after seeing the initial roll but before any of the roll's effects occur. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

subclasses.name: The Genie
subclasses.description: Warlocks who bind themselves to a noble genie, gaining elemental powers and a magical vessel.

features.name: Genie's Vessel
features.description: Your patron gifts you a magical vessel, a Tiny object that serves as a spellcasting focus and grants you a refuge. As an action, you can magically vanish and enter the vessel, remaining inside for a number of hours equal to twice your proficiency bonus. While inside, you can hear the area around the vessel.

features.name: Genie's Wrath
features.description: Once during each of your turns when you hit with an attack roll, you can deal extra damage of a type determined by your patron (bludgeoning for dao, thunder for djinni, fire for efreeti, cold for marid) equal to your proficiency bonus.

subclasses.name: The Great Old One
