subclasses.description: Warlocks whose patron is a mysterious entity from the Far Realm, granting psychic and mind-bending abilities.

features.name: Awakened Mind
features.description: You can telepathically speak to any creature you can see within 30 feet. You don't need to share a language with the creature for it to understand your telepathic utterances, but the creature must be able to understand at least one language.

features.name: Entropic Ward
features.description: When a creature makes an attack roll against you, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on that roll. If the attack misses you, your next attack roll against the creature has advantage if you make it before the end of your next turn.

subclasses.name: The Hexblade
subclasses.description: Warlocks who forge a pact with a mysterious entity from the Shadowfell, manifesting as a sentient weapon.

features.name: Hexblade's Curse
features.description: As a bonus action, you can place a curse on a creature you can see within 30 feet. For 1 minute, you gain a bonus to damage rolls against the cursed target equal to your proficiency bonus, your attacks against it score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20, and if the cursed target dies, you regain hit points equal to your warlock level + Charisma modifier.

features.name: Hex Warrior
features.description: You gain proficiency with medium armor, shields, and martial weapons. When you finish a long rest, you can touch one weapon and use your Charisma modifier for attack and damage rolls with it instead of Strength or Dexterity.

subclasses.name: The Undead
subclasses.description: Warlocks who form a pact with a deathless being, gaining the ability to assume a terrifying undead form.

features.name: Form of Dread
features.description: As a bonus action, you can transform for 1 minute, gaining temporary hit points equal to 1d10 + your warlock level. Once during each of your turns, when you hit a creature with an attack, you can force it to make a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of you until the end of your next turn. You are immune to the frightened condition.

features.name: Grave Touched
features.description: You don't need to eat, drink, or breathe. Once during each of your turns when you hit a creature with an attack, you can change the damage type to necrotic and roll one additional damage die.

subclasses.name: The Undying
subclasses.description: Warlocks whose patron has achieved mastery over death, granting abilities to resist dying and ward off undead.

features.name: Among the Dead
features.description: You learn the spare the dying cantrip. You also have advantage on saving throws against any disease. If an undead targets you directly with an attack or a harmful spell, it must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature must choose a new target or forfeit targeting someone.

features.name: Defy Death
features.description: When you succeed on a death saving throw or stabilize a creature with spare the dying, you regain hit points equal to 1d8 + your Constitution modifier.

name: Wizard
description: A scholarly magic-user capable of manipulating the structures of reality through careful study, wielding the broadest and most versatile selection of spells.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: As a student of arcane magic, you have a spellbook containing spells that show the first glimmerings of your true power. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability. You know three cantrips and prepare spells from your spellbook each day.

features.name: Arcane Recovery
features.description: Once per day when you finish a short rest, you can recover expended spell slots with a combined level equal to or less than half your wizard level (rounded up), and none of the slots can be 6th level or higher.

features.name: Spell Mastery
features.description: You have achieved such mastery over certain spells that you can cast them at will. Choose a 1st-level and a 2nd-level wizard spell in your spellbook. You can cast those spells at their lowest level without expending a spell slot.

features.name: Signature Spells
features.description: You gain mastery over two powerful spells and can cast them with little effort. Choose two 3rd-level wizard spells in your spellbook. You always have these spells prepared and can cast each of them once at 3rd level without expending a spell slot.

subclasses.name: School of Abjuration
subclasses.description: Wizards who specialize in protective magic, creating wards and banishing harmful effects.

features.name: Abjuration Savant
features.description: The gold and time you must spend to copy an abjuration spell into your spellbook is halved.

features.name: Arcane Ward
features.description: You can weave magic around yourself for protection. When you cast an abjuration spell of 1st level or higher, you create a magical ward that has hit points equal to twice your wizard level + your Intelligence modifier. Whenever you take damage, the ward takes the damage instead.

subclasses.name: School of Bladesinging
subclasses.description: Wizards who practice an elven tradition of combining swordplay with arcane magic in an elegant dance of blades.

features.name: Training in War and Song
features.description: You gain proficiency with light armor and with one type of one-handed melee weapon of your choice.

features.name: Bladesong
features.description: You can invoke a secret elven magic called the Bladesong as a bonus action, gaining a bonus to AC equal to your Intelligence modifier, walking speed increases by 10 feet, advantage on Acrobatics checks, and a bonus to Constitution saving throws to maintain concentration, all lasting for 1 minute.

subclasses.name: School of Chronurgy
subclasses.description: Wizards who manipulate the flow of time, bending moments to their will.

features.name: Chronal Shift
features.description: After you or a creature you can see within 30 feet makes an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can use your reaction to force the creature to reroll. You can use this feature twice per long rest.

features.name: Temporal Awareness
features.description: You can add your Intelligence modifier to your initiative rolls.

subclasses.name: School of Conjuration
subclasses.description: Wizards who specialize in summoning creatures and conjuring objects and transport.

features.name: Conjuration Savant
features.description: The gold and time you must spend to copy a conjuration spell into your spellbook is halved.

features.name: Minor Conjuration
features.description: As an action, you can conjure up an inanimate object in your hand or on the ground in an unoccupied space within 10 feet. The object can be no larger than 3 feet on a side and weigh no more than 10 pounds, and it must be in the form of a nonmagical object you have seen.

subclasses.name: School of Divination
subclasses.description: Wizards who peer into the future and unlock the secrets of the multiverse through prescient magic.

features.name: Divination Savant
features.description: The gold and time you must spend to copy a divination spell into your spellbook is halved.

features.name: Portent
features.description: When you finish a long rest, roll two d20s and record the numbers rolled. You can replace any attack roll, saving throw, or ability check made by you or a creature that you can see with one of these foretelling rolls. You must choose to do so before the roll.

subclasses.name: School of Enchantment
subclasses.description: Wizards who specialize in magically entrancing and beguiling other people and monsters.

features.name: Enchantment Savant
features.description: The gold and time you must spend to copy an enchantment spell into your spellbook is halved.

features.name: Hypnotic Gaze
features.description: As an action, choose one creature you can see within 5 feet. If the target can see or hear you, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you until the end of your next turn. The charmed creature's speed drops to 0 and the creature is incapacitated.

subclasses.name: School of Evocation
subclasses.description: Wizards who focus on creating powerful elemental effects such as blasts of fire, bolts of lightning, and walls of ice.

features.name: Evocation Savant
features.description: The gold and time you must spend to copy an evocation spell into your spellbook is halved.

features.name: Sculpt Spells
features.description: When you cast an evocation spell that affects other creatures that you can see, you can choose a number of them equal to 1 + the spell's level. The chosen creatures automatically succeed on their saving throws against the spell and take no damage if they would normally take half damage on a successful save.

subclasses.name: School of Graviturgy
subclasses.description: Wizards who study the manipulation of gravity, bending the forces that attract and repel objects and creatures.

features.name: Adjust Density
features.description: As an action, you can magically alter the weight of one Large or smaller object or creature within 30 feet. The object's weight is halved or doubled for up to 1 minute. A creature affected by halved weight has increased speed and jump distance, while doubled weight has reduced speed.

features.name: Gravity Well
features.description: Whenever you cast a spell that deals damage, you can move any creature affected by the spell 5 feet toward or away from the center of the spell's origin.

subclasses.name: School of Illusion
subclasses.description: Wizards who focus on magic that dazzles the senses, befuddles the mind, and tricks even the wisest folk.

features.name: Illusion Savant
features.description: The gold and time you must spend to copy an illusion spell into your spellbook is halved.

features.name: Improved Minor Illusion
features.description: You learn the minor illusion cantrip. When you cast minor illusion, you can create both a sound and an image with a single casting of the spell.

subclasses.name: School of Necromancy
subclasses.description: Wizards who explore the cosmic forces of life and death, learning to command undead and drain life energy.

features.name: Necromancy Savant
features.description: The gold and time you must spend to copy a necromancy spell into your spellbook is halved.

features.name: Grim Harvest
features.description: Once per turn when you kill one or more creatures with a spell of 1st level or higher, you regain hit points equal to twice the spell's level, or three times its level if the spell belongs to the School of Necromancy. You don't gain this benefit for killing constructs or undead.

subclasses.name: Order of Scribes
subclasses.description: Wizards who develop a mystically sentient spellbook, a companion that aids them in their studies and adventures.

features.name: Wizardly Quill
features.description: As a bonus action, you can magically create a Tiny quill in your free hand. The magic quill has the following properties: it doesn't require ink, the time you must spend to copy a spell into your spellbook is halved, and you can erase text written with the quill as a bonus action.

features.name: Awakened Spellbook
features.description: Your spellbook gains sentience. While holding the book, you can use it as a spellcasting focus, and when you cast a wizard spell with a spell slot, you can temporarily replace its damage type with a type that appears in another spell in your spellbook. You also gain the ability to cast ritual spells in 10 minutes rather than the usual extra time.

subclasses.name: School of Transmutation
subclasses.description: Wizards who study spells that modify energy and matter, transforming substances and reshaping reality.

features.name: Transmutation Savant
features.description: The gold and time you must spend to copy a transmutation spell into your spellbook is halved.

features.name: Minor Alchemy
features.description: You can temporarily alter the physical properties of one nonmagical object, changing it from one substance into another (e.g., wood to stone, iron to copper). The transformation lasts for 1 hour or until you lose your concentration.

subclasses.name: School of War Magic
subclasses.description: Wizards who blend arcane principles with combat training, creating a formidable combination of defense and offense.

features.name: Arcane Deflection
features.description: When you are hit by an attack or fail a saving throw, you can use your reaction to gain a +2 bonus to AC or a +4 bonus to the saving throw. When you use this feature, you can't cast spells other than cantrips until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Tactical Wit
features.description: You can add your Intelligence modifier to your initiative rolls.

name: Artificer
description: A master of invention who uses ingenuity and magic to unlock extraordinary capabilities in objects, crafting magical items and infusing mundane objects with arcane energy.
tool_proficiencies: One type of artisan's tools of your choice

features.name: Magical Tinkering
features.description: You learn how to invest a spark of magic into mundane objects. You can touch a Tiny nonmagical object and give it one of the following magical properties: emit light, emit a recorded message, emit an odor or nonverbal sound, or display a static visual effect.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You have studied the workings of magic and how to channel it through objects. You must have a spellcasting focus — specifically thieves' tools or some kind of artisan's tool — in hand when you cast any spell with this feature. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability.

features.name: Infuse Item
features.description: You gain the ability to imbue mundane items with certain magical infusions. At the end of a long rest, you can touch a nonmagical object and imbue it with one of your artificer infusions, turning it into a magic item.

features.name: The Right Tool for the Job
features.description: You learn how to produce exactly the tool you need. With thieves' tools or artisan's tools in hand, you can magically create one set of artisan's tools in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you over the course of 1 hour.

features.name: Flash of Genius
features.description: When you or another creature you can see within 30 feet makes an ability check or a saving throw, you can use your reaction to add your Intelligence modifier to the roll. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier per long rest.

subclasses.name: Alchemist
subclasses.description: Artificers who specialize in combining reagents to produce mystical effects, brewing potions and elixirs.

features.name: Experimental Elixir
features.description: Whenever you finish a long rest, you can magically produce an experimental elixir in an empty flask. Roll on the Experimental Elixir table for the effect (healing, swiftness, resilience, boldness, flight, or transformation). A creature can drink the elixir as an action.

features.name: Alchemical Savant
features.description: When you cast a spell using your alchemist's supplies as the spellcasting focus, you gain a bonus to one roll of the spell equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum +1) for healing, acid, fire, necrotic, or poison damage or restoring hit points.

subclasses.name: Armorer
subclasses.description: Artificers who specialize in modifying armor into a powerful arcane conduit, turning suits of armor into magical power armor.

features.name: Arcane Armor
features.description: You can turn a suit of armor into Arcane Armor by performing a special ritual. It now counts as light armor, ignores any Strength requirement, and can be used as a spellcasting focus. You choose one of two models: Guardian (thunder gauntlets, defensive field) or Infiltrator (lightning launcher, speed boost, advantage on Stealth).

features.name: Armor Model
features.description: You can customize your Arcane Armor: Guardian model for tank-like defense with thunder gauntlets (1d8 thunder damage, target has disadvantage on attacks against others) or Infiltrator model for ranged attacks and stealth (lightning launcher dealing 1d6 lightning damage at 90 feet, +5 ft speed, advantage on Stealth).

subclasses.name: Artillerist
subclasses.description: Artificers who specialize in using magic to hurl energy, projectiles, and explosions through eldritch cannons.

features.name: Eldritch Cannon
features.description: You learn how to create a magical cannon. As an action, you can magically create a Small or Tiny eldritch cannon in an unoccupied space. Choose its form: Flamethrower (15-foot cone, 2d8 fire damage), Force Ballista (ranged attack, 2d8 force damage and push), or Protector (1d8 + Int modifier temporary HP in 10-foot radius).

features.name: Arcane Firearm
features.description: You can use a rod, staff, or wand as your arcane firearm spellcasting focus. When you cast an artificer spell through the firearm, roll a d8 and add the number rolled to one damage roll of the spell.

subclasses.name: Battle Smith
subclasses.description: Artificers who combine combat prowess with magical craftsmanship, fighting alongside a steel defender companion.

features.name: Battle Ready
features.description: You gain proficiency with martial weapons. When you attack with a magic weapon, you can use your Intelligence modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity for attack and damage rolls.

features.name: Steel Defender
features.description: Your tinkering has borne you a faithful companion, a steel defender. It is friendly to you and your companions, obeys your commands, and acts on your initiative. In combat, it can use its reaction to impose disadvantage on an attack roll against a creature within 5 feet of it.
